problem: The requirement applies only when a structural member spans across a hull-area boundary, but this node shape is applied to every structural member reached from a ship and unconditionally requires at least one spanned hull area.
required_change: Represent the boundary-spanning condition explicitly and apply the hull-area-factor cardinality and maximum-selection constraints only to applicable members; do not reject non-spanning structural members.
regression_guard: Preserve applicability as conditional on spanning across a hull-area boundary.

problem: The exact largest hull area factor is not required: the query accepts selectedHullAreaFactor values within an invented relative-plus-absolute tolerance of 1e-6, although the requirement specifies that the largest factor is to be used and declares no tolerance.
required_change: Require exact equality between the selected factor and the MAX hullAreaFactor value, subject only to any explicitly authorized numeric comparison semantics.
regression_guard: Preserve the exact maximum requirement and do not introduce an unstated tolerance.
